snippet.title: Skigill - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Skigill is a roguelite survival game that takes place on huge skill trees. 

The demo is out now on Steam! 
Come play Skigill at the Steam Next Fest on the 13th of October, or get it on the 31st!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3657180/Skigill/

Music and SFX by Noé Guiton  @noeguiton  .
